paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.

model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of two methods, “Vanilla CoT” and “TLDR (Ours)”, across four datasets: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names, listed in the order GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. For each dataset, there are two bars representing each method. “Vanilla CoT” is represented by a yellow bar, while “TLDR (Ours)” is represented by a green bar; the bars are paired side-by-side. For GSM8K, “Vanilla CoT” reaches a value of 92.5% and “TLDR (Ours)” reaches 86.4%; for MATH500, “Vanilla CoT” reaches 86.4% while “TLDR (Ours)” reaches 79.6%, for AIME, “Vanilla CoT” reaches 43.4% and “TLDR (Ours)” reaches 43.4%, and for AMC, “Vanilla CoT” reaches 79.6% while “TLDR (Ours)” reaches 92.5%. Each bar is accompanied by a text label indicating the percentage change in accuracy compared to “Vanilla CoT”, presented in red for negative changes and green for positive changes. The bars are not sorted by any obvious criteria, and there is no visual emphasis, such as shading or outlining, placed on any particular bar.
